stem: Which outcome was an important effect of the 1898 event illustrated by this map?

options.label: A
options.text: Increased U.S. foreign aid to the developing countries in South America

options.label: B
options.text: Increased U.S. public support for the construction of a canal through Central America

options.label: C
options.text: Decreased U.S. economic influence in the Western Hemisphere

options.label: D
options.text: Decreased U.S. naval presence in the Caribbean Sea

visual_elements: Map showing voyage of the USS Oregon from San Francisco, California in March 1898 to Jupiter Inlet, Florida in May 1898
Compass rose with N, E, S, W directions
notes: The question relates to the 1898 voyage of the USS Oregon and its impact; answer choices relate to U.S. influence and naval presence.
